Team — reviewed MerchantCo's VAT certificate and transaction detail. Recommended approach for EU (Spain):
1) Do NOT issue an amended invoice for gross VAT removal — instead issue a credit memo (CM-20270416) that references INV-20270331 and includes a reverse-charge statement. That preserves our original invoice history and provides MerchantCo the documentation they need for local VAT reclaim.
2) When releasing escrow, ensure the credit memo line shows VAT 0% with 'Reverse charge - Article 196' language.
3) Keep a copy of MerchantCo's VAT cert in the tax folder and note the evidence id in the credit memo.

Marissa — with that direction please proceed to queue the journal and post the credit memo. Karthik — your sign-off required for the journal (amount €14,320).

-David
